entities.summary: Annette Kurschus is a German Protestant theologian and pastor. She was Praeses of the Protestant Church of Westphalia from 2012 until 2023, in November 2015 she became vice-president of the Council of the Protestant Church in Germany. She was President of the Council of the EKD from 2021 until 2023.
